cues.en: Mike: I wanna start this video by reminding you of something I discussed in one of the earlier videos in this section, and that was that there are two kind of strategies,
cues.zh: Mike：影片一開始，先提醒這一章較早的某部影片討論過的內容，就是有兩種策略，

cues.en: two families of approaches.
cues.zh: 兩大類處理方法。

cues.en: You might call them different philosophies of dealing with outliers in data.
cues.zh: 也可以說，是處理資料中離群值的不同哲學。

cues.en: One strategy is to identify outliers and remove them from the data before you do any analyses.
cues.zh: 一種策略是，在任何分析之前，先辨識並移除離群值。

cues.en: And that is most of what I've been talking about in this section.
cues.zh: 這也是這一章大部分內容在談的事。

cues.en: So Z-score method and modified Z-score, Euclidean distance from multivariate trimming and so on.
cues.zh: 例如 Z 分數、修正 Z 分數、多變量的歐幾里得距離、資料修剪等等。

cues.en: And again, the assumption underlying those methods is that outliers are noise, they're invalid, they're non-representative,
cues.zh: 同樣地，這些方法背後的假設是，離群值是雜訊、無效、不具代表性，

cues.en: and we do not want them contaminating the data sets.
cues.zh: 而我們不希望它們污染資料集。

cues.en: But that's not the, you know, that's just one way of thinking about outliers.
cues.zh: 但這只是看待離群值的一種方式。

cues.en: There is another way of thinking about outliers, which is that they are unusual.
cues.zh: 另一種看法是，它們的確不尋常。

cues.en: They're a little bit different, but they're still valid data.
cues.zh: 稍微不同，但仍然是有效資料。

cues.en: And so there's no particular reason to throw them out.
cues.zh: 因此，沒有什麼特別理由把它們丟掉。

cues.en: It's not justified to throw out the data because we believe that they are real, valid data.
cues.zh: 因為相信它們是真實、有效的資料，所以沒有充分理由將它們移除。

cues.en: So if you make that assumption, if that is a valid assumption, then in fact what you should be doing is leaving the outliers in and using alternative statistical methods
cues.zh: 如果採取這個假設，而且假設成立，實際上應該保留離群值，改用其他統計方法，

cues.en: that are robust to outliers.
cues.zh: 也就是對離群值具有穩健性的方法。

cues.en: And that is the main goal of this video.
cues.zh: 這就是這部影片的主要目標。

cues.en: I'm going to introduce you to a list of non-parametric data analysis, statistical analyses, that are robust to outliers, so that are not really affected
cues.zh: 我要介紹一系列無母數資料分析、統計分析，它們對離群值具有穩健性，也就是不太會受到

cues.en: by the presence of outliers.
cues.zh: 離群值存在的影響。

cues.en: Now, I haven't yet told you about any of the terms on this slide.
cues.zh: 目前還沒有介紹這張投影片上的任何術語。

cues.en: I also haven't defined yet what a parametric test means and what is like the opposite of a parametric test, a non-parametric test.
cues.zh: 也還沒定義什麼是母數檢定，以及它的相對概念，也就是無母數檢定。

cues.en: So that's okay.
cues.zh: 這沒關係。

cues.en: The main thing I want to point out in this video is that there are many, many statistical procedures that have a corresponding non-parametric version.
cues.zh: 這部影片主要想指出，很多很多統計程序，都有對應的無母數版本。

cues.en: And in general, non-parametric tests, non-parametric statistical tests are robust to outliers.
cues.zh: 一般而言，無母數統計檢定對離群值具有穩健性。

cues.en: They're much less sensitive to outliers.
cues.zh: 對離群值的敏感度低得多。

cues.en: And parametric tests tend to be more sensitive to outliers.
cues.zh: 母數檢定則通常比較敏感。

cues.en: So maybe you've heard of some of these things.
cues.zh: 也許你聽過其中一些。

cues.en: I assume you've heard of some of these, at least some of these items.
cues.zh: 我想至少聽過這裡一部分項目。

cues.en: I'm sure you've heard of t-tests, correlations.
cues.zh: 一定聽過 t 檢定、相關。

cues.en: You probably have heard of ANOVA, even if you're not really sure exactly what it is.
cues.zh: 可能也聽過 ANOVA，即使不太確定它到底是什麼。

cues.en: You've probably heard that name before.
cues.zh: 大概以前聽過這個名稱。

cues.en: These are the non-parametric versions of these tests.
cues.zh: 這些就是它們的無母數版本。

cues.en: And you may not have heard of these.
cues.zh: 這些名稱你可能沒聽過。

cues.en: There's the sign-rank tests and U test, Spearman correlation and so on.
cues.zh: 例如符號等級檢定、U 檢定、Spearman 相關等等。

cues.en: There's a whole family of statistical inference called permutation testing, and you're going to learn all about these various methods later on in the course.
cues.zh: 還有一整類統計推論，稱為置換檢定；這些不同方法，課程後面都會學到。

cues.en: The only reason why I'm showing you all these names now is just to get the idea already in your head that for, not for every single parametric test,
cues.zh: 現在展示這些名稱，唯一的原因只是先讓你建立這個概念：不是每一種母數檢定，

cues.en: but for many statistical tests that are sensitive to outliers, there are often, not always, but quite often, a non-parametric version
cues.zh: 但很多對離群值敏感的統計檢定，經常，不是總是，但相當常見地，會有一個無母數版本，

cues.en: that is less sensitive to outliers.
cues.zh: 比較不容易受離群值影響。

cues.en: And do you know why this is?
cues.zh: 你知道為什麼嗎？

cues.en: If you have some experience with statistics, maybe you know why these methods, non-parametric methods are less sensitive to outliers.
cues.zh: 如果有一些統計經驗，也許知道為什麼這些無母數方法對離群值比較不敏感。

cues.en: So it turns out that the answer is, so these methods, I'm actually referring to these methods here, not these ones.
cues.zh: 答案是，這些方法，我其實是指這裡這些，不是那邊那些，

cues.en: The answer is that non-parametric tests tend to be based on either medians or ranks.
cues.zh: 答案是，無母數檢定通常以中位數或秩為基礎。

cues.en: And as you already know, both the median and the rank transform are insensitive to outliers.
cues.zh: 你已經知道，中位數和秩轉換都不容易受到離群值影響。

cues.en: And that's why these methods are insensitive to outliers or robust to outliers.
cues.zh: 因此，這些方法對離群值不敏感，或者說具有穩健性。

cues.en: Okay, so again, the main point of this lecture was to remind you of the two strategies for dealing with outliers.
cues.zh: 好，這堂課的主要重點，是提醒你處理離群值的兩種策略。

cues.en: You shouldn't think that the only way to deal with outliers is to remove them.
cues.zh: 不要以為唯一的處理方式就是移除。

cues.en: There's a whole other category of procedures for dealing with outliers, and that is to leave them in the data but make sure you are using analyses that aren't going
cues.zh: 還有另一大類程序，是保留資料中的離群值，但確保使用的分析不會

cues.en: to be biased by those outliers.
cues.zh: 因這些離群值而產生偏誤。

cues.en: And then I gave you, you know, I threw up a bunch of names.
cues.zh: 接著我給你，或者說丟出了一堆名稱。

cues.en: I threw up a bunch of tests on the slide, but don't worry too much about memorizing that list.
cues.zh: 在投影片列了很多檢定，但不用太擔心記住那份清單。

cues.en: I will explain all of those later on through the course.
cues.zh: 課程後面會一一解釋。
